en.headline: Hong Kong women reach Asian Games squash final
en.dek: Ho Tze-lok won the decider against India as the team advanced 2-1 in Nagoya, while sailors added silver and bronze in the 49er class on day 12.
body: Hong Kong, China's women's squash team reached the Asian Games final after a 2-1 semi-final win over India on Thursday in Nagoya.

Chan Sin-yuk came from behind to beat Anahat Singh 3-2. India levelled when Tanvi Khanna recovered from a lost first game to defeat Lee Ka-yi 3-1. Ho Tze-lok then beat Joshna Chinappa 3-0 in the decider, 11-4, 11-7, 11-9, sending Hong Kong into Friday's gold-medal match. There is no bronze play-off, so India takes bronze.

On the water, Russell Aylsworth and Akira Luke Sakai won bronze in the men's 49er skiff behind China and India. Emily Poulson and Tiffany Mak Hui-tung took silver in the women's 49er, finishing behind host Japan, with China third.
Hong Kong squash teams have now reached the last four in both the men's and women's events at five consecutive Asian Games since team competition began in Guangzhou in 2010.

zh.headline: 亞運女子壁球隊晉級決賽
zh.dek: 何子樂擊敗印度對手鎖定2比1勝局，港隊周五爭金；帆船49人級同日添一銀一銅。
body: 港隊女子壁球在名古屋亞運四強以2比1擊敗印度，晉身決賽。
陳善鈺先以3比2擊敗辛格。印度譚維汗娜由先失一局反勝李嘉琪3比1追平。何子樂在決勝場以11比4、11比7、11比9直落三盤擊敗芝娜帕，港隊周五爭金。隊際賽沒有季軍戰，印度獲得銅牌。
帆賽方面，艾爾斯沃思與坂井在男子雙人快速艇艉49人級取得銅牌，金銀牌分屬中國及印度。女子組普珲麗與麥曉彤奪銀，金牌歸東道主日本，中國得銅。
自2010年廣州亞運增設隊際賽以來，港隊男女子壁球隊已連續五屆打入四強。
